purpose: Deterministic environment-only validation of the Research_Basic visual observation, action, reward, end, and reset contract. This is not training.

observation.reset: Capture one post-reset frame and copy it into all four stack channels before the first decision.

actions.order: Apply the lateral movement once at the policy decision, then fire the fixed center-camera hitscan if Shoot is selected.
actions.mask_rule: Only outward movement at the two lateral boundaries is masked.

geometry.target_sampling: Unsigned 32-bit quickdraw.basic-target-slot.v1 hash of scenario_seed and zero-based episode_index, modulo nine slots.

weapon.aim: visible fixed crosshair centered on the same camera viewport ray used by hitscan

reset: Reset the agent to lateral slot zero.
Place the target from the explicit scenario seed and episode index.
Reset decision, shot, miss, reward, and policy-runner telemetry counters.
Reset deterministic random state from explicit seeds.
Capture one post-reset frame and fill all four stack channels.

random.rule: Uniformly sample each branch from its mechanically available actions.

scripted.rule: Threshold the newest grayscale frame, move toward the bright target centroid, and shoot only when centered. No privileged target state is read.

comparison.rule: For the same policy and registered seeds, the canonical traces must be structurally and numerically identical across fresh standalone processes.
